title: Advanced automatic ad and segment skipping
message: Optimized automatic Skip Ad and segment detection with targeted player scans, support for countdown-enabled controls, configurable categories and lower page overhead.
features: Automatic click of supported visible and enabled Skip Ad controls, including countdown-to-enabled transitions
Twelve configurable segment categories and SponsorBlock-style page metadata mapping
Master automatic-skip setting with allowlist-aware behavior
Targeted player-root scans, cached settings and animation-frame mutation batching
No media/DRM manipulation; ads without a supported skip control cannot be skipped
